$description: Scaalus colour palette v3.1 — three hero colours (Navy, Scaalus Blue, Mist), the three logo colours, and fourteen support colours, including the v2 Cobalt and Electric blues. Blue leads every post; the logo's indigo and violet are accents only. No other hex values are allowed.

logo-blue.$description: LOGO · FIXED. The blue end of the logo gradient. Glows, mass highlights, Daylight circle start, accent bar start.

scaalus.name: Logo Blue
scaalus.text: Never small text (4.1:1 under white). Headline-size white text only.

logo-indigo.$description: LOGO · FIXED · ACCENT ONLY. Middle of the logo gradient. Accent bar, highlight end on light, small glow hints. Never a ground or a main mass.

scaalus.name: Logo Indigo
scaalus.text: Highlight end on light grounds (5.5:1 on Mist).

logo-violet.$description: LOGO · FIXED · ACCENT ONLY. Violet end of the logo gradient. Accent bar end and Daylight circle end — never more than about 5% of a frame.

scaalus.name: Logo Violet
scaalus.text: Never text.

royal.$description: HERO. The brand's one vivid blue: buttons, pills and highlight start on light, the Royal ground, Royal Aurora end.

scaalus.name: Scaalus Blue
scaalus.text: Highlight start on light (5.0:1 on Cloud). Carries white text (6.2:1).

navy-royal.$description: Middle of the Royal Aurora, Royal ground start, highlight end on light, pill text on white.

scaalus.name: Navy Royal
scaalus.text: Highlight end and pill text on light (8.9:1 on Cloud).

royal-blue.$description: Back from v2. The middle of the Electric aurora and the Cobalt ground; pill and button text on white on Cobalt.

scaalus.name: Royal Blue
scaalus.text: Pill and button text on White (10.6:1). Never text on dark.

cobalt.$description: Back from v2. The bright end of the Cobalt ground.

scaalus.name: Cobalt
scaalus.text: Never text. Carries white text (8.0:1).

electric.$description: Back from v2. The vivid end of the Electric aurora — inside the colour mass only, never a flat ground.

scaalus.name: Electric
scaalus.text: Never text on dark (2.4:1 on Night Blue). Carries white headline text (7.2:1).

periwinkle.$description: Highlight end on dark, rings, glows and sheen.

scaalus.name: Periwinkle
scaalus.text: Highlight words on dark (7.7:1 on Deep Blue). Never text on light.

ice.$description: Highlight start and pills on dark, rings and borders on light.

scaalus.name: Ice
scaalus.text: Highlight and pill fill on dark (10.9:1 on Deep Blue). Never text on light.

navy.$description: HERO. The brand's own navy (from v1.0, kept by request): headlines on light (14.9:1 on white), the Midnight and Royal Aurora darks, dark buttons on light.

scaalus.name: Navy
scaalus.text: Headlines, list text and dark buttons on light.

deep-royal.$description: Back from v2 (was Deep Blue). The dark start of the Cobalt ground; Cobalt surfaces.

scaalus.name: Deep Royal
scaalus.text: Never text.

night-blue.$description: Back from v2. Electric ground start and Electric aurora start.

scaalus.name: Night Blue
scaalus.text: Never text.

abyss.$description: Darkest ground stop (Electric, Midnight). Shadow tint on dark.

scaalus.name: Abyss
scaalus.text: Never text.

white.$description: Headlines on dark, cards on light, Daylight ground start, glass.

scaalus.name: White
scaalus.text: Headlines on every dark mood.

mist.$description: HERO. The light of the system: the cool white ground for light posts (Daylight end, Sky start, Frost).

scaalus.name: Mist
scaalus.text: Never text.

cloud.$description: Sky ground end, pills and borders on light, supporting text on Royal.

scaalus.name: Cloud
scaalus.text: Supporting and meta text on Royal (5.0:1).

slate-blue.$description: Supporting and meta text on light. Tinted blue, never grey.

scaalus.name: Slate Blue
scaalus.text: Supporting and meta on every light mood (7.7:1 on Cloud).

scaalus.name: Haze
scaalus.text: Supporting on Electric and Midnight.

fog.$description: Meta text on dark: counters, small labels, the scaalus.com line.

scaalus.name: Fog
scaalus.text: Meta on Electric and Midnight.

logo-only.$description: Sampled from the official logo files. The wordmark ink lives only inside the logo.

retired.never: Purple or violet as a ground, a main mass or a large fill (the logo's violet is an accent only). No teal, cyan-green, yellow, orange, red or coral — accent colours are a separate decision.
